item.tib: sgra bla dar thul ma'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: dang po stag la me 'bar gyis mdzad/ de nas stong rgyung gis mdzad/ de nas hris pa gyer rgyung gis mdzad/ khod spungs bdag gis bstan pa bsrung / phyi rabs gshen gyi don du sra ba rtsi yi byug g+hi wang gis mdangs gtod/ mi lang pa 'dra ba'i gangs seng ge 'dra ba'i 'og tu/ (?) g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i rgyas gdab ste sbas/ phyi rabs gshen gyi don du las skal par ldan pa/ blo bzang rig pa can dang 'phrad par shog 'phrad nas bon gyi bstan pa bsrung bar shog zla zla rgya rgya/ (?)ton rdzogs so//
